name: agent-companion
description: Delegate in plain language from Codex CLI to an OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or Google Antigravity companion. Give the subagent a task, an absolute repo or worktree path, and any companion or model preference. Continue the same subagent for follow-ups.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to a companion coding agent in plain language.
interface.longDescription: Adds a subagent that hands work to OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex CLI, or Google Antigravity and brings the answer back. Give it a task, an absolute repo or worktree path, and optionally a companion or model. Ask for available choices through the read-only catalog. Send follow-ups to the same subagent to continue the conversation; spawn a new one for independent work. Run long work in the background. Codex registers the internal bridge at plugin scope so the subagent can inherit it.
defaultPrompt: Ask the agent companion to review this repository
Delegate this implementation to the agent companion
